title: Bat wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,32 62,32' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,20 56,20' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 47,14 53,14' fill='#4fd8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='30,36 26,16 42,30' fill='#8a5cff'/>
  <polygon points='70,36 74,16 58,30' fill='#8a5cff'/>
  <polygon points='32,34 30,23 39,31' fill='#c98bff'/>
  <polygon points='68,34 70,23 61,31' fill='#c98bff'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <path d='M30,52 Q8,44 4,60 Q10,70 26,66 Q20,58 30,52 Z' fill='#7a3ad9'/>
  <path d='M70,52 Q92,44 96,60 Q90,70 74,66 Q80,58 70,52 Z' fill='#7a3ad9'/>
  <path d='M28,54 Q14,50 10,60 Q16,66 26,62 Z' fill='#a86bff'/>
  <path d='M72,54 Q86,50 90,60 Q84,66 74,62 Z' fill='#a86bff'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='22' ry='24' fill='#8a5cff'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='17' fill='#9d6bff'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#c9a4ff'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#2b1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#2b1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='39' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='50,45 46,49 54,49' fill='#ff7ab8'/>
  <!-- mouth + fangs -->
  <path d='M44,52 Q50,56 56,52' stroke='#5a3a9a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <polygon points='45,52 47,52 46,56' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='53,52 55,52 54,56' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
